transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I’m here because my sleep has been really broken for a long time. I’ll go to bed exhausted, but then I wake up at every little sound in the house. And a lot of mornings I’m up before the alarm, feeling like I didn’t really rest at all.
Do you often feel anxious or worried around bedtime or during the night when you're trying to sleep?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’m lying there worrying about anything specific most nights. I just wake up easily, and then it’s hard to feel settled again.
Outside of bedtime or during the night, do you find yourself feeling anxious or tense during the day?
Not really, no. I mean, I get a little tense with normal stuff during the day, but I haven’t noticed feeling anxious all the time or anything like that.
How often do you have trouble staying asleep or falling asleep—does this happen on most nights, or is it more occasional?

It happens most nights, honestly. I usually fall into bed exhausted, but my sleep is really broken—I wake up at little sounds, and a lot of mornings I’m awake before the alarm feeling like I never really rested.
Do you usually have trouble falling asleep at the beginning of the night, or do you often wake up earlier than you'd like in the morning?

It’s more that I wake up too early, and I wake up a lot. I usually fall into bed exhausted, but then every little sound seems to wake me, and by morning I’m up before the alarm feeling like I didn’t really sleep.
Do you often wake up feeling unrefreshed, like your sleep didn’t really restore you, even if you were asleep for a long time?

Yes, that’s pretty much what happens. Even if I’ve been in bed for hours, I wake up feeling like I didn’t really get real rest. I’m exhausted, but my sleep is so broken that it doesn’t feel like it helps.
Do you often feel very sleepy during the day, like you could fall asleep even if you're trying to stay awake?

Yes, a lot of days I do feel that way. I’m already exhausted from the broken sleep, and even when I’m trying to get going, I feel like I could nod off. It’s like I never really got rested in the first place.
Do you feel unrefreshed even when you’ve had a full night without interruptions or disturbances?

I don’t really get a full night without interruptions, honestly. My sleep is usually broken—I wake up at little sounds, and then I’m up before the alarm. So even after being in bed all night, I feel like I never really rested.
Even on nights when you have plenty of time to sleep and there are no interruptions, do you still wake up feeling unrefreshed?

Honestly, I’m not sure I really have nights like that. For a long time my sleep has just been broken—I’m exhausted when I go to bed, but I wake up to every little sound, and then I’m usually up before the alarm feeling like I never really rested.
Even when you have a chance to sleep without being woken up by sounds, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t really rest?

Yes. Even when I’m not woken up by anything obvious, I still tend to wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest. I fall into bed exhausted, but by morning I’m up before the alarm and just feel worn out.
Even when you’ve had enough time in bed and there were no interruptions, do you still wake up feeling like your sleep didn’t refresh you?
Yes, that’s pretty much how it feels. Even if I’ve been in bed long enough, I still wake up before the alarm feeling like I didn’t really rest. It’s like my sleep just doesn’t refresh me.
Even when you’ve had enough time in bed and your sleep wasn’t interrupted, do you still wake up feeling like it wasn’t refreshing or restful?

Yes. I know I’ve said it, but that’s exactly it—I can be in bed long enough and still wake up before the alarm feeling like I never really rested. My sleep just feels broken, even when there isn’t one clear thing waking me up.
Even on nights when you don’t wake up during the night, do you still wake up feeling like your sleep wasn’t restful or refreshing?
Yes. Even on nights like that, I’ll wake up before the alarm feeling worn out, like the sleep didn’t do much for me. It just doesn’t feel restful.
Even when you’ve had plenty of time in bed and your sleep wasn’t interrupted, do you still consistently wake up feeling like your sleep wasn’t restful or refreshing?
Yes. That’s been going on for a long time. I can fall into bed exhausted and still wake up to every little sound, and then I’m up before the alarm feeling like I never really rested.
Even when you’ve had plenty of time in bed and your sleep wasn’t interrupted, do you still consistently wake up feeling like your sleep wasn’t restful or refreshing?

Yes. I know I’ve said it a few times, but that’s really what’s been happening. Even if I’m in bed long enough, my sleep feels broken, and I’ll wake up before the alarm feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Even when you’ve had plenty of time in bed, and your sleep wasn’t interrupted by noises or other things, do you still wake up feeling like your sleep wasn’t restful or refreshing?
Yes. Even when nothing really wakes me up, I still get up feeling like I didn’t actually rest. I’m exhausted going to bed, and then I’m awake before the alarm like the sleep just didn’t do much.
Even when you’ve had plenty of time in bed, and your sleep wasn’t interrupted by noises or other things, do you still wake up feeling like your sleep wasn’t restful or refreshing?
Yes, I do. Even when I’ve been in bed long enough, I wake up feeling like I didn’t really get rested. It’s like I’m exhausted when I lie down, and then I’m still up before the alarm feeling worn out.
